manifest.name: ErvisioRepo
manifest.author: Riccardo Reccia
manifest.description: Install and manage ErvisioRepo on this machine: settings, storage and runners, and publish the Git server on its own web address (git.<domain>) through Caddy.

commands.description: Read the state of caddy.service and the Caddyfile it loads (to offer a web address for the Git server)
commands.name: service-show

commands.description: Check the Caddyfile with caddy validate before Caddy reloads it (in a scratch data folder, so nothing in Caddy's storage changes)
commands.name: validate

commands.description: Reload caddy.service after adding or removing the Git server's site
commands.name: reload

commands.description: Check whether Docker is installed (to find the Caddy containers, and before installing with Docker)
commands.name: has-docker

commands.description: Read your user name (root uses Docker without an unlock prompt)
commands.name: user

commands.description: Read your groups (members of docker use Docker without an unlock prompt)
commands.name: groups

argv: systemctl stop ervisio-repo-install.service 2>/dev/null; systemctl reset-failed ervisio-repo-install.service 2>/dev/null; exec systemd-run --unit=ervisio-repo-install --description='Install ErvisioRepo (Docker)' --remain-after-exit --setenv=PATH=/usr/local/sbin:/usr/local/bin:/usr/sbin:/usr/bin:/sbin:/bin sh -c "$0" install-docker "$1" "$2" "$3"

set -eu
v="$1"; email="$2"; url="$3"; d=/opt/ervisio-repo
command -v docker >/dev/null || { echo "Docker is not installed"; exit 1; }
if [ ! -f "$d/deploy/docker/compose.yaml" ]; then
  mkdir -p "$d"
  u="https://github.com/Ervisio/ErvisioRepo/archive/refs/tags/v$v.tar.gz"
  echo "Downloading $u"
  if command -v curl >/dev/null; then curl -fsSL "$u"; else wget -qO- "$u"; fi | tar -xz --strip-components=1 -C "$d"
fi
cd "$d/deploy/docker"
exec ./setup.sh --non-interactive --ervisio yes --admin-email "$email" --url "$url"
commands.description: Install ErvisioRepo with Docker in /opt/ervisio-repo: download the release matching this plugin from GitHub and run deploy/docker/setup.sh --ervisio yes in a systemd unit (ervisio-repo-install), which starts the Docker Compose stack
commands.name: install-docker

argv: systemctl stop ervisio-repo-install.service 2>/dev/null; systemctl reset-failed ervisio-repo-install.service 2>/dev/null; exec systemd-run --unit=ervisio-repo-install --description='Install ErvisioRepo (native)' --remain-after-exit --setenv=PATH=/usr/local/sbin:/usr/local/bin:/usr/sbin:/usr/bin:/sbin:/bin sh -c "$0" install-native "$1"

set -eu
v="$1"
u="https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Ervisio/ErvisioRepo/v$v/deploy/install.sh"
echo "Downloading $u"
if command -v curl >/dev/null; then curl -fsSL "$u"; else wget -qO- "$u"; fi | sh -s -- --version "$v"
commands.description: Install ErvisioRepo as a native package (deploy/install.sh of the release matching this plugin: downloads, verifies the signature, installs with apt or dnf) in a systemd unit (ervisio-repo-install)
commands.name: install-native

commands.description: Read the state of the installation unit (ervisio-repo-install)
commands.name: install-state

commands.description: Read the output of the installation (the journal of ervisio-repo-install)
commands.name: install-log
